geometry.hypothesis: Body-specific collision witnesses admit a physical CAD region and feasible point-force support for at least two brace strategies.
geometry.correction: Require CAD boundary distance <=0.5 mm and normal agreement <=25 degrees; preserve each witness point and lever arm.
geometry.tolerance_basis: 0.5 mm and 25 degrees inherited from validated catalogue; geometry tolerances, not measured hardware compliance.
geometry.region_definition: Implicit union of collision-boundary points within 0.5 mm of a same-body CAD triangle with outward normal within 25 degrees. No smoothing across holes or other bodies.
geometry.region_capacity: Point forces only. No area, pressure limit, torsional moment or hardware load rating is credited.
